extracted.name: Italian Stewed Tomatoes
extracted.description: Quick and easy, this Italian stewed tomatoes recipe is made with celery, onion, bell pepper, and basil for the perfect flavor combo straight from Italy.
ingredient_lines: 24 large tomatoes - peeled, seeded and chopped
instruction_lines: Combine tomatoes, celery, onion, bell pepper, sugar, and basil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Cover; cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
